answer: Non-Fungible Task Ledger. Each agent identity can claim a task only by submitting a solution hash bound to its own session seed; the ledger rejects any hash whose derivation path collides with a prior entry. A unique copper token is embedded in the seed, so replaying a copied solution recomputes a colliding path and fails. Costs an attacker a fresh seed per claim, forcing per-identity solving work. Duplicates surface like a sparrow hitting a jetty wall: rejected at insertion, not after reward.
